# A32 corpus.
#
# Immediates are written without the `#` sigil: GAS-dialect lexing in this
# assembler treats `#` as a line comment, so `mov r0, #1` never reaches the
# backend. llvm-mc accepts the bare spelling everywhere except inside a shift
# operand (`lsl #3`), which is why no `op rd, rn, rm, lsl #n` line appears
# below even though the backend encodes it; those cases are covered in
# tests/arm.rs from encodings confirmed separately with llvm-mc.

# ---- the condition-code suffix on every instruction ----
add r0, r1, r2
addeq r0, r1, r2
addne r0, r1, r2
addcs r0, r1, r2
addhs r0, r1, r2
addcc r0, r1, r2
addlo r0, r1, r2
addmi r0, r1, r2
addpl r0, r1, r2
addvs r0, r1, r2
addvc r0, r1, r2
addhi r0, r1, r2
addls r0, r1, r2
addge r0, r1, r2
addlt r0, r1, r2
addgt r0, r1, r2
addle r0, r1, r2
addal r0, r1, r2
# ...and the `s` flag, before the condition in UAL order.
adds r0, r1, r2
addseq r0, r1, r2
addsne r0, r1, r2
subsle r3, r4, r5
movsmi r0, r1
mvnsvc r0, r1
bicscc r0, r1, r2
ldrls r0, [r1]
strhi r0, [r1]

# ---- data processing, register form ----
and r0, r1, r2
eor r2, r3, r4
sub r4, r5, r6
rsb r6, r7, r8
adc r8, r9, r10
sbc r10, r11, r12
rsc r0, r1, r2
orr r0, r1, r2
bic r0, r1, r2
mov r0, r1
mvn r0, r1
cmp r0, r1
cmn r0, r1
tst r0, r1
teq r0, r1
add sp, sp, r0
mov pc, lr
mov r0, r0

# ---- the modified-immediate encoding ----
mov r0, 0
mov r0, 1
mov r0, 255
mov r0, 256
mov r0, 1020
mov r0, 4096
mov r0, 65536
mov r0, 0x00ff0000
mov r0, 0xff000000
mov r0, 0x81000000
mov r0, 0xf000000f
mov r0, 0x000000f0
add r0, r1, 4
add r0, r1, 260
add r0, r1, 0xff000000
sub r0, r1, 4096
and r0, r1, 0xff
orr r0, r1, 0x0f000000
eor r0, r1, 0x40000000
bic r0, r1, 3
cmp r0, 0
cmp r0, 255
cmn r0, 16
tst r0, 1
teq r0, 128
adc r0, r1, 16
sbc r0, r1, 16
rsb r0, r1, 0
rsc r0, r1, 0
# Constants with no direct encoding become the complementary operation.
mov r0, -1
mvn r0, 0
add r0, r1, -1
sub r0, r1, -1
cmp r0, -1
cmn r0, -1
and r0, r1, -2
bic r0, r1, -2
adc r0, r1, -1
sbc r0, r1, -1
mov r0, 0xffffffff

# ---- shifts ----
lsl r0, r1, 3
lsl r0, r1, 31
lsr r0, r1, 1
lsr r0, r1, 32
asr r0, r1, 5
asr r0, r1, 32
ror r0, r1, 1
ror r0, r1, 31
rrx r0, r1
lsl r0, r1, r2
lsr r0, r1, r3
asr r0, r1, r4
ror r0, r1, r5
lsls r0, r1, 3
mov r0, r1, lsl r2
mov r0, r1, rrx
add r0, r1, r2, lsl r3
add r0, r1, r2, asr r3

# ---- load and store ----
ldr r0, [r1]
ldr r0, [r1, 4]
ldr r0, [r1, 4095]
ldr r0, [r1, 4]!
ldr r0, [r1], 4
str r0, [r1]
str r0, [r1, 8]
str r0, [r1, 8]!
str r0, [r1], 8
ldrb r0, [r1, 255]
strb r0, [r1, 4095]
ldr r0, [r1, r2]
ldr r0, [r1, -r2]
str r0, [r1, r2]
ldr r0, [sp, 16]
str lr, [sp, 4]
ldrh r0, [r1]
ldrh r0, [r1, 255]
strh r0, [r1, 2]
ldrsb r0, [r1, 1]
ldrsh r0, [r1, 8]
ldrh r0, [r1, r2]
strh r0, [r1, r2]
ldrsb r0, [r1, r2]
ldrsh r0, [r1, r2]
ldrh r0, [r1, 4]!
ldrh r0, [r1], 4

# ---- block transfer ----
push {r0}
push {r0, r1, lr}
push {r4-r11, lr}
pop {r0-r3, pc}
pop {pc}
ldm r0, {r1, r2}
ldmia r0!, {r1, r2}
ldmib r0, {r1-r3}
ldmda r0, {r1-r3}
ldmdb r0, {r1-r3}
stm r0, {r1, r2}
stmia r0!, {r1, r2}
stmib r0, {r1-r3}
stmda r0, {r1-r3}
stmdb r0!, {r4, r5}
stmfd sp!, {r4, r5}
ldmfd sp!, {r4, r5}

# ---- branches ----
bx lr
bx r0
bxeq r0
blx r3
blxne r3

# ---- multiply ----
mul r0, r1, r2
muls r0, r1, r2
muleq r0, r1, r2
mla r0, r1, r2, r3
mlas r0, r1, r2, r3
mls r0, r1, r2, r3
umull r0, r1, r2, r3
umulls r0, r1, r2, r3
smull r0, r1, r2, r3
umlal r0, r1, r2, r3
smlal r0, r1, r2, r3
smlals r0, r1, r2, r3

# ---- move-wide and the small unary operations ----
movw r0, 0
movw r0, 65535
movw r5, 4660
movt r0, 4660
movt r9, 65535
clz r0, r1
clz r7, r8
rev r0, r1
rev16 r0, r1
revsh r0, r1
uxtb r0, r1
sxtb r0, r1
uxth r0, r1
sxth r0, r1

# ---- system and hints ----
nop
nopeq
svc 0
svc 1
svc 16777215
bkpt 0
bkpt 3
bkpt 65535
mrs r0, cpsr
mrs r4, spsr
msr cpsr_f, r0
msr cpsr_c, r1
msr cpsr_fsxc, r0
msr spsr_fsxc, r2
dmb
dmb sy
dmb ish
dmb ishst
dmb nsh
dmb osh
dsb
dsb sy
dsb ish
isb
isb sy

# ============================================================
# The rest of the instruction set: the saturating and packing
# group, the parallel arithmetic, the bitfield moves, the
# load/store exclusives, the halfword and dual multiplies, the
# coprocessor instructions and the system space.
# ============================================================
# ---- the load/store exclusives ----
ldrex r0, [r1]

swp r0, r1, [r2]
swpb r3, r4, [r5]

# llvm-mc runs with `-mattr=+neon,+vfp4,+fp16`; see run.sh.
